Round-trip: Stage 1 → generated text → Stage 2

STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: control_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: control_combined.v · Open raw
module control(
		input  wire	[5:0]	opcode,
		output reg			branch_eq, branch_ne,
		output reg [1:0]	aluop,
		output reg			memread, memwrite, memtoreg,
		output reg			regdst, regwrite, alusrc,
		output reg			jump);

	always @(*) begin
		/* defaults */
		aluop[1:0]	<= 2'b10;
		alusrc		<= 1'b0;
		branch_eq	<= 1'b0;
		branch_ne	<= 1'b0;
		memread		<= 1'b0;
		memtoreg	<= 1'b0;
		memwrite	<= 1'b0;
		regdst		<= 1'b1;
		regwrite	<= 1'b1;
		jump		<= 1'b0;

		case (opcode)
			6'b100011: begin	/* lw */
				memread  <= 1'b1;
				regdst   <= 1'b0;
				memtoreg <= 1'b1;
				aluop[1] <= 1'b0;
				alusrc   <= 1'b1;
			end
			6'b001000: begin	/* addi */
				regdst   <= 1'b0;
				aluop[1] <= 1'b0;
				alusrc   <= 1'b1;
			end
			6'b000100: begin	/* beq */
				aluop[0]  <= 1'b1;
				aluop[1]  <= 1'b0;
				branch_eq <= 1'b1;
				regwrite  <= 1'b0;
			end
			6'b101011: begin	/* sw */
				memwrite <= 1'b1;
				aluop[1] <= 1'b0;
				alusrc   <= 1'b1;
				regwrite <= 1'b0;
			end
			6'b000101: begin	/* bne */
				aluop[0]  <= 1'b1;
				aluop[1]  <= 1'b0;
				branch_ne <= 1'b1;
				regwrite  <= 1'b0;
			end
			6'b000000: begin	/* add */
			end
			6'b000010: begin	/* j jump */
				jump <= 1'b1;
			end
		endcase
	end
endmodule
STAGE 2

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name control.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.

Private final evaluation

Reference RTLClean RTL in the imported source record; hidden from Stage 2.
Score / oracleBinary formal equivalence to the hidden clean module

The formal oracle consumes the complete Stage 2 RTL file and compares it with the clean reference. A golden RTL file is scoring material, not a generated Stage 1 output.
